verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents an `exec`/headless mode for CI pipelines that runs one task to completion and exits (byteask-docs-19), plus approval-gated actions and sandboxed writes — but nothing describes always-on scheduling, cron-like triggers, or persistent background agents that autonomously monitor and fix a codebase over time. The evidence only supports one-shot invocation from external CI systems, not a built-in autonomy/scheduling feature.
